Lunar-Crystallize

Type

Elemental Reactions

Group

Lunar Reactions

Lunar-Crystallize is the Lunar Reaction triggered by inflicting Geo on a target that is already affected by Hydro, replacing Hydro Crystallize while a character with a corresponding Moonsign Benediction Passive is in the party. After triggering a Lunar-Crystallize reaction, three Moondrifts will be generated nearby. After a certain number of Lunar-Crystallize triggers on the field, Moondrifts will resonate and unleash Moondrift Harmony, each launching a projectile that tracks nearby targets and deals Geo DMG.

Damage[]

Main article: Damage § Lunar Reaction Damage

When Lunar-Crystallize is triggered, three Moondrifts will be created around the target. While a Moondrift is on the field, every third Lunar-Crystallize reaction will cause Moondrifts to resonate and initiate Moondrift Harmony, firing a projectile that tracks the target and deals Geo DMG.
Moondrifts are considered Geo constructs.

Tutorial[]

Elemental Reaction: Lunar-Crystallize
When Geo meets Hydro, and certain other conditions are met, a special Lunar-Crystallize reaction occurs, and three Moondrifts will form near the target.
Triggering the Lunar-Crystallize reaction three times will initiate Moondrift Harmony, which deals Geo DMG to nearby opponents.
This DMG can trigger CRIT Hits, and the DMG dealt is based on all characters who have applied elements during the reaction.
